market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Fed meeting + oil shock + inflation data create two-way risk. Energy up, consumer down. AI names bifurcate (revenue vs. speculation). Expect 3-5% index volatility. Bond yields likely to spike pre-Fed.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI earnings contribution (50% of S&P 500) supports growth but dot-com comparison warrants caution. Energy inflation may normalize post-supply recovery. Consumer recovery depends on wage-inflation gap closing. India/EM offer diversification. Buffett/Apple validation supports quality-over-quantity thesis.
